keyLimits.en: Full Revit BIM software, annual subscription billed as USD 3,005/year (approx. USD 250/month equivalent) for one seat; a 3-year term is also offered at USD 9,020 total; a monthly plan is billed at USD 380/month.

Lighter, lower-cost edition of Revit for small teams and sole practitioners; USD 560/year (about USD 46.67/month equivalent), or USD 70/month billed monthly; feature set is reduced compared to full Revit (e.g. no worksharing/multi-user collaboration).

cautions.en: Autodesk no longer sells perpetual licenses for Revit; a subscription (monthly, annual, or 3-year term) is the only way to access the software.
Revit LT is a separate, cheaper edition with reduced functionality (e.g. no multi-user worksharing), not simply a discount on full Revit; the two should not be treated as the same plan tier.

capabilities.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM) for architectural design, structural engineering and MEP (mechanical/electrical/plumbing).
Automatically coordinates plans, elevations, sections and schedules from a single parametric building model.
Cloud services for collaboration and access to previous software versions included with an active subscription.

limitations.en: No perpetual license option; access requires an ongoing paid subscription indefinitely.
Revit LT, the lower-cost edition, drops key collaboration features (such as multi-user worksharing) compared to full Revit.

reason.en: Direct BIM competitor for architectural design, already listed as a current alternative for Revit.
Lower-cost 3D modeling tool used by smaller practices as an alternative or complement to full BIM software like Revit.
